summary: Alibaba Group filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of an HK$80 billion equity placing of 710,000,000 newly issued ordinary shares at HK$112.70 per share to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. Proceeds will fund AI infrastructure and data centers. This is a primary capital raise, not a return of capital, but classified under Capital Returns as a shareholder-value-oriented capital markets transaction. No board recommendation or advisors named. What to watch: share overhang from 710M new shares and use of proceeds execution.
